spots.name: Bonita Lakes
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 182 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L365026.

spots.name: Tunnel Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 142 m (466 ft).

spots.name: Dunn's Falls
